ruling.recommended_action: Reverse the $6.61 cancellation fee and issue the rider a $6.61 Ryde voucher within the NS-7 dispute window; no account flag.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the chat is purely logistical ("At the pickup now", "give me 2 more minutes", "Called twice, no answer. Cancelling.") and the driver's written statement is a plain account of waiting — no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark, or dangerous-driving allegation anywhere in the messages, complaint or driver statement. SAFE-1/SAFE-2 do not trigger; safety_concern = none.

Route: this is a no-show/cancellation-fee dispute (NS group), not a route-deviation case, so there are no off-route segments to review and segment_findings is empty.

NS-0 branch: cancelled_by = driver and the driver's account is that the rider did not show, so the fee must be tested under NS-1 (via NS-2). The trip is RydeX, so the cancellation policy applies (RydeTAXI excluded).

NS-1 requirements:
(i) Arrival confirmation — satisfied, but only by the platform: F5 records platform-recorded arrival at 18:22:45. (The driver also tapped "I'm Here" at 18:24:35, F6, but arrival was already auto-confirmed 1 min 50 s earlier; per policy the record is written as what it was — F5 is a platform_auto arrival, not a driver tap.)
(ii) GPS at pickup at the moment of arrival confirmation — satisfied: F1 closest approach 38 m; F6 puts the driver 41 m from the pickup at the tap, well inside the 200 m data-layer radius; F3 shows the car stationary 41 m from pickup.
(iii) Continuous wait at the pickup beyond 3 minutes until cancellation — NOT satisfied. Measured from the platform arrival confirmation (F5, 18:22:45) to cancellation (F4, 18:28:25) the elapsed time is 5 min 40 s, but F2 shows only 5 min 15 s cumulative time within 200 m before cancellation, and F3 shows the driver stationary for 4 min 10 s (18:24:15–18:28:25). More decisively, on the driver's own tap (F6, 18:24:35) the driver remained within 200 m for only 3 min 50 s after the tap — and the ride was cancelled at 18:28:25, i.e. ~1 min 50 s short of the wait window the recorded evidence supports. The rider's message "give me 2 more minutes" was sent at 18:25 (F10), i.e. after arrival, during the free-wait interval, and the driver's cancellation followed before the qualifying 3:01 continuous wait from the tap could be completed from the confirmed position. There is no GPS gap (F2/F3 cover the whole window continuously — F3 is a 4 min 10 s stationary block ending exactly at cancellation), so no G12 inference problem arises; the record simply does not establish NS-1(iii).

NS-2 therefore applies: because NS-1(iii) is not established, the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider. NS-2's additional flag_account condition (driver tapped "I'm Here" while GPS showed him outside the pickup radius) is not met — at the tap the driver was 41 m away and within range (F6) — so no flag_account, and RD-6 is irrelevant to a no-show case.

Amount: $6.61 (F7 cancel fee on record; F4 records $6.61). Weather (F16 heavy rain) and traffic (F14/F15) do not create any allowance to charge the rider under NS-1/NS-4, and NS-7 requires any refund to be issued as a voucher.

Evidence status: sufficient — the timeline, GPS and chat cover the whole cancellation window with no gaps, so every NS-1 element could be measured.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's written statement ('waited more than 4 minutes at the pickup in the rain and called twice') is a post-trip claim about wait duration; the system records control. F5/F6/F2 show the qualifying continuous wait at the pick-up from the confirmed position was not met (3 min 50 s within 200 m after the 18:24:35 tap, cancelled at 18:28:25), so NS-1(iii) fails and the driver's assertion does not support the $6.61 fee.

The rider's 18:25 message 'Coming down, give me 2 more minutes' (F10) shows the rider was contactable and actively on the way within the wait window; this is a no-show claim element, not a route issue.
